lines.trans: Cooks, quickly stand at your places, everyone!
Right now our restaurant is opening its doors for guests.
Get started immediately with your work in the kitchen!
Chef, why are you so very angry today?
The new owner took away all my expensive alcohol!

words.gram: nominative singular, masculine, used in address

lines.trans: Did he really forbid you to drink at work?
Yes, now a dry law is in effect in the kitchen.

words.gram: particle in the set phrase да ну

lines.trans: Without wine it will be hard for you to cook dishes.
Enough chatting, start cutting the fresh meat!

words.gram: future, 3rd person singular, perfective; хватит! = enough!

lines.trans: I already prepared a delicious sauce for the fish.
And I will now put the hot soup on the stove.
Today every dish of ours must be ideal.
Fine, chef, we will do everything very quickly!

words.gram: nominative neuter singular, used as a noun

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

встать.gloss: to stand up, to get up

examples.trans: First come, first served (whoever got up first gets the slippers).

He is running for a second term.

на его место = in his place

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: a door, window, bottle, or business

examples.trans: I'm going to open it now.

The door is behind the wardrobe.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.

meanings.en: to begin, to start, to proceed to

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

person who owns a business or property

examples.trans: The owner of the restaurant came out into the dining room.

забрать.gloss: to take back, to take away

meanings.note: забрать заявление = to withdraw a statement
to a loved one, and at the start of letters

examples.trans: Are you planning to drink alcohol?

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.

meanings.note: used on its own: он пьёт = he drinks

examples.trans: Come on, Danya, go. Get to work!

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.trans: It is very hard to manage it.
